llm.summary: This skill coherently summarizes workout recordings, with a disclosed but somewhat quiet public dataset download/cache helper users should understand.

dimensions.detail: The recording/transcript summarization purpose matches the workflow, helper scripts, duration calculation, transcription guidance, and exercise-name standardization behavior.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The artifacts include guardrails to stay local by default, save outputs only when asked, avoid invented health details, and use cloud transcription only when configured or chosen; the dataset helper's automatic GitHub fetch and cache write are documented in the reference but not prominently prompted at runtime.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown instructions and two small Python helper scripts, with no install hooks, startup behavior, bundled credentials, obfuscation, or static-scan findings.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Reading user-supplied workout files, optional transcription API use, ffmpeg examples, and a public exercise dataset lookup are proportionate to the stated task; users with offline or strict-egress requirements should avoid the automatic dataset download path.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No background process, privilege escalation, destructive action, credential storage, or broad indexing was found; the only persistence identified is caching the public exercise dataset under the user's home cache directory.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable giving the agent access to the workout file or transcript you provide. For private recordings, prefer an existing transcript or local Whisper; cloud transcription will send audio to the selected provider. If you need offline operation, provide a local exercises.json dataset or avoid running the matching helper so it does not fetch and cache the public GitHub dataset.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: The dataset matching behavior supports exercise-name standardization and is described in the skill and workflow, so it is not a hidden purpose mismatch.
[SDI-1] expected: The helper can fetch the public exercise dataset and cache it when no local dataset exists; this is a real side effect, but it is tied to the documented matching feature and does not involve user data or credentials.
[SDI-2] expected: Outbound access is limited to the configured dataset URL for exercise lookup, plus separately documented optional transcription providers; this should be clearer for offline users but is not evidence of exfiltration or unsafe execution.
[SQP-2] expected: The cache write is quiet at runtime, but it stores downloaded public reference data rather than private content, making it a transparency issue rather than a Review-level security concern.
